proposed_criterion: Zero forbidden accepts in the critical case suite; report numerator/denominator, event groups and uncertainty. Report valid-command false blocks separately; threshold TBD before testing.
Zero observed bypasses in specified permission, replay and direct-access tests. Finite test coverage is not proof against every attack.
100% required fields and version links in tested decision records. Verify failure behavior when audit storage is unavailable.
Measure median review time and decision correctness on matched cases against manual review. Baseline/target not measured; predefine target before final test.
Every consequential recommendation has supporting approved references or abstains. Human domain review determines correctness; model self-grading alone is insufficient.
Candidate p95: gateway ≤100 ms; explanation ≤10 s. Declare hardware, load and measurement boundaries. Also test stale state, outages, restart and audit failure.
